GPT-5.6 cascade filter — GUI rejected candidates

The official GUI rule (first point inside the GT box) is exact, but each screenshot annotates ONE control while the model often lands on an equivalent one: calibration measured that only ~52% of officially-wrong GUI answers are genuinely off target. Every such candidate is therefore adjudicated by two outside judges that never see the GT box: gpt-5.6-luna screens all 46,562 candidates, and gpt-5.6-sol re-checks the ones luna calls off_target. A candidate is used as a training rejected sample only if BOTH say off_target: 20,454 kept (44%). Each judge saw the instruction plus two views: the whole screen with a red marker on the model's point, and an upscaled crop around that point. Judged with reasoning_effort=medium; calibration below (ceiling = points provably inside the GT box, floor = random points outside it; n=130/130/200 per arm).
